assets.name: agent-studio-hero
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mature cloud-platform website hero banner, landscape 1536 x 640 requested.
Primary request: a polished original 3D scene evoking a unified AI Agent workspace.
Scene/backdrop: luminous pale ice-blue seamless background, a gentle almost-white gradient, airy clean premium studio.
Subject: on the RIGHT side only, one original compact rounded white porcelain robot assistant with mature understated industrial design, minimal small dark horizontal eye marks, no oversized eyes, no childish expression; a translucent azure blue four-point inspiration star, one or two delicate glass orbital rings, and a few small glossy spheres.
Composition/framing: panoramic landscape. Keep the LEFT 60 percent entirely clean, bright, and nearly featureless for a black headline overlay. Place the hero arrangement in the RIGHT 40 percent, comfortably contained inside the frame. Refined sparse composition with generous breathing room.
Lighting/mood: warm refined softness, diffused studio highlights, gentle realistic ambient and contact shadows, sophisticated quiet product photography.
Color palette: white porcelain, clear frosted glass, pale ice blue, restrained vivid sky blue. No purple.
Materials/textures: beautifully smooth glazed white ceramic, transparent and translucent blue glass, soft physically realistic reflections and subtle refractions.
Constraints: no text anywhere, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no user interface, no screenshots. Original robot design, not a branded mascot. Avoid giant cute eyes, toy-like childish mood, purple neon, dark background, busy decoration.

assets.name: agent-feature-triptych
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide 3D feature illustration triptych, requested aspect ratio exactly 3:1, 1536 x 512.
Primary request: three separate premium 3D product-feature objects on a completely white seamless background, arranged horizontally at equal scale and consistent perspective.
Scene/backdrop: pure white background (#FFFFFF), only gentle soft contact shadows beneath the objects.
Subject: LEFT at x=1/6: a crystalline translucent azure blue four-point inspiration star with a delicate curved glass arc; CENTER at x=1/2: a pale blue glass shield with one solid white checkmark inside; RIGHT at x=5/6: a blue glass conversation bubble with a pair of small clean white knowledge cards, cards have no text or lines.
Composition/framing: three equally wide invisible zones, objects centered exactly at one sixth, one half, and five sixths of the canvas width. Each feature object occupies approximately 65 percent of its own zone. None of the groups overlap or approach neighboring groups. Generous white margins, comfortable padding top and bottom, same scale.
Lighting/mood: refined high-end studio product photography, large softbox, restrained white highlights, soft delicate shadows, luminous but subtle.
Color palette: white, pale ice blue, restrained bright sky blue only.
Materials/textures: smooth transparent and frosted blue glass with white ceramic accents, consistent materials, illumination, and elevated three-quarter viewing angle throughout.
Constraints: image only, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no UI screenshot, no frames, no dividers, no decorative lines, no purple neon, no extra objects. Checkmark is permitted as the central shield symbol.
